correctness.rationale: The counterclockwise oriented triangle-boundary columns form a full-rank matrix B with Gram G=BᵗB=3I-A_T, T the max-degree-three dual tree. The quadratic identity for 3I-A proves positive definiteness; the convergent adjacency-walk Neumann expansion proves strict positivity of every entry of G^-1. Each crosspolytope facet sign epsilon has squared normal norm epsilonᵗG^-1epsilon, maximal exactly for epsilon=±1; two opposite facets bound the true arbitrary-center insphere radius (1ᵗG^-1 1)^-1/2, and all optimal centers occupy a relative (m-1)-dimensional neighborhood in the orthogonal hyperplane (no others outside that hyperplane). For paths, solve 3x_i-x_(i-1)-x_(i+1)=1 with zero endpoints, giving stated tau-formula. For complete binary height h solve the radial tree recurrence with root and leaf boundary, giving S_h=2m-h-1-(h+2)(h+1/(m+1))/(2-1/(m+1)). Thus S_path/m→1, S_binary/m→2 and radius_binary/radius_path→1/sqrt2. Independently verified exact rational G inverses for paths m=1..10 and full binary heights 0..4 and all sign facets for small m. The prior all-tree theorem supplies the same universal identity; that is an originality issue, not a correctness defect.
